description: This photo album features a golden dots designer printed cover with the words Live, Laugh, Love. There is also a frame on the front cover to insert a favorite photo as well as a deluxe rounded book bound spine. The album holds 200 photos up to 4 x 6 inches in optically clear pockets with a shaded paper background. There is a memo writing area next to each pocket. Photos are displayed two per page. Archival, photo safe: acid, lignin and PVC free.
